info.title: zendesk (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Simulated zendesk API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

get.summary: Retrieve all tickets in the helpdesk. Fetches every support case, issue, or request regardless of status.
get.description: Retrieve all tickets in the helpdesk. Fetches every support case, issue, or request regardless of status.

post.summary: Open a new support ticket. Submits a fresh helpdesk request with a subject, description, priority, status, and assignee.
post.description: Open a new support ticket. Submits a fresh helpdesk request with a subject, description, priority, status, and assignee.

requestBody.description: {ticket: {subject, description?, status?, priority?, type?, requester_id?, requester_email?, requester_name?, assignee_id?, group_id?, tags?, external_id?}}

get.summary: Fetch a single ticket by its numeric ID. Looks up one specific support case or issue.
get.description: Fetch a single ticket by its numeric ID. Looks up one specific support case or issue.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the ticket to fetch.

patch.summary: Modify an existing ticket. Change a support case's status, priority, assignee, group, tags, or subject. Optionally inclu
patch.description: Modify an existing ticket. Change a support case's status, priority, assignee, group, tags, or subject. Optionally include a comment with the update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the ticket to modify.

requestBody.description: {ticket: {subject?, status?, priority?, type?, assignee_id?, group_id?, organization_id?, tags?, comment?: {body (string), public? (boolean), author_id? (string)}}}

get.summary: Query tickets by keyword or attribute. Locate support cases matching a subject, description, or Zendesk search expressio
get.description: Query tickets by keyword or attribute. Locate support cases matching a subject, description, or Zendesk search expression.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search expression (searches subject and description). Supports Zendesk query syntax e.g. 'status:open type:ticket'.

get.summary: Get all comments on a ticket. Returns the full conversation thread, including public replies and internal notes.
get.description: Get all comments on a ticket. Returns the full conversation thread, including public replies and internal notes.

parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the ticket whose comments are being fetched.

put.summary: Attach tags to a ticket. Applies one or more labels to categorize a support case.
put.description: Attach tags to a ticket. Applies one or more labels to categorize a support case.

parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the ticket to tag.

delete.summary: Strip tags from a ticket. Removes specified labels from a support case.
delete.description: Strip tags from a ticket. Removes specified labels from a support case.

parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the ticket to untag.

get.summary: Return all users in Zendesk. Retrieves every agent, end-user, and admin account in the system.
get.description: Return all users in Zendesk. Retrieves every agent, end-user, and admin account in the system.

post.summary: Register a new user. Adds a fresh agent, end-user, or admin account to the Zendesk instance.
post.description: Register a new user. Adds a fresh agent, end-user, or admin account to the Zendesk instance.

requestBody.description: {user: {name, email?, phone?, role?, organization_id?, tags?, details?, notes?, external_id?, verified?}}

get.summary: Fetch a single user by their numeric ID. Retrieves one agent, customer, or admin account.
get.description: Fetch a single user by their numeric ID. Retrieves one agent, customer, or admin account.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the user to fetch.

put.summary: Change an existing user's attributes. Update a user's name, email, phone, role, organization, tags, notes, or details.
put.description: Change an existing user's attributes. Update a user's name, email, phone, role, organization, tags, notes, or details.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the user to update.

requestBody.description: {user: {name?, email?, phone?, role?, organization_id?, tags?, details?, notes?, verified?}}

delete.summary: Remove a user. Deletes or deactivates an agent, customer, or admin account from Zendesk.
delete.description: Remove a user. Deletes or deactivates an agent, customer, or admin account from Zendesk.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the user to remove.

get.summary: Find users by name or email. Queries agents, customers, and contacts matching the search term.
get.description: Find users by name or email. Queries agents, customers, and contacts matching the search term.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term matching against name and email fields.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Locate a user by their exact email address.

post.description: Look up a user by email and return them, or create a new user if no match is found. Upserts a user record by email.

get.summary: Return all organizations in Zendesk. Lists every company, account, or organizational group in the system.
get.description: Return all organizations in Zendesk. Lists every company, account, or organizational group in the system.

post.summary: Register a new organization. Adds a fresh company, account, or organizational group to Zendesk.
post.description: Register a new organization. Adds a fresh company, account, or organizational group to Zendesk.

requestBody.description: {organization: {name, domain_names?, details?, notes?, tags?, group_id?, shared_tickets?, shared_comments?, external_id?}}

get.summary: Fetch a single organization by its numeric ID. Retrieves one company or account record.
get.description: Fetch a single organization by its numeric ID. Retrieves one company or account record.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the organization to fetch.

put.summary: Change an existing organization's attributes. Update a company's name, domains, details, notes, tags, or sharing configu
put.description: Change an existing organization's attributes. Update a company's name, domains, details, notes, tags, or sharing configuration.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the organization to update.

requestBody.description: {organization: {name?, domain_names?, details?, notes?, tags?, shared_tickets?, shared_comments?}}

get.summary: Query organizations by name. Finds matching companies or accounts in Zendesk.
get.description: Query organizations by name. Finds matching companies or accounts in Zendesk.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term matched against organization names.

post.summary: Look up an organization by name and return it, or create a new one if no match is found. Upserts an organization record.
post.description: Look up an organization by name and return it, or create a new one if no match is found. Upserts an organization record.

get.summary: Return all groups in Zendesk. Lists every agent team or department configured in the system.
get.description: Return all groups in Zendesk. Lists every agent team or department configured in the system.

get.summary: Fetch a single agent group by its numeric ID. Retrieves one team or department record.
get.description: Fetch a single agent group by its numeric ID. Retrieves one team or department record.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the group to fetch.

subject.description: Title or headline of the ticket.

description.description: Initial message describing the reported issue (read-only after the ticket is created).

requester_id.description: Identifier of the user who submitted the ticket.

assignee_id.description: Identifier of the agent handling the ticket.

group_id.description: Identifier of the team assigned to the ticket.

external_id.description: Reference ID for connecting to external platforms.

created_at.description: When the ticket was originally created.

updated_at.description: When the ticket was most recently modified.

public.description: Whether the comment is visible to the requester.

author_id.description: Identifier of the user who wrote the comment.

email.description: Email address associated with the user account.

role.description: Access level assigned to the user.

organization_id.description: Identifier of the organization this user belongs to.

details.description: Additional descriptive information about the user.

notes.description: Internal notes recorded about the user.

external_id.description: Reference identifier from an external system.

verified.description: Whether the user's identity has been confirmed.

domain_names.description: Email domains associated with this organization.

group_id.description: Default team assigned to new tickets from this organization.

shared_tickets.description: Determines whether tickets are visible across all organization members.

shared_comments.description: Determines whether members of the organization can view and comment on each other's tickets.
